original_text: Practice Exercise¨On a sheet of paper using C and H atoms only, draw the following:¤A 5 carbon structure¤A 3 carbon structure¤A 4 carbon structure with a single bonded –OH group
explanation: This is a student practice exercise. It asks students to draw three carbon-based structures using carbon (C) and hydrogen (H) atoms only: a 5-carbon structure, a 3-carbon structure, and a 4-carbon structure that includes a single-bonded hydroxyl (-OH) group.

questions.q: Which functional group is requested to be drawn on the 4-carbon structure in this practice exercise?
questions.exp: The prompt asks to draw 'a 4 carbon structure with a single bonded –OH group', which is a hydroxyl group.
